vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Guten Morgen, hast du gut geschlafen?
vocabularies.targetPhrase: Good morning, did you sleep well?

vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Guten Tag, wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
vocabularies.targetPhrase: Good day, how can I help you?
Excuse me, where is the train station?

vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Mein Vater arbeitet in der Stadt.
vocabularies.targetPhrase: My father works in the city.
My brother likes to play football.
Our son is learning to play the piano.
My grandmother likes to tell stories.

vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Mein Großvater liest jeden Tag Zeitung.
vocabularies.targetPhrase: My grandfather reads the newspaper every day.

vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Mein Onkel hat einen großen Garten.
vocabularies.targetPhrase: My uncle has a big garden.

vocabularies.sourcePhrase: Meine Eltern wohnen auf dem Land.
vocabularies.targetPhrase: My parents live in the countryside.
I want to have a car.
I want to become a teacher.
